title: Taylor Swift Surprises ‘Toy Story 5’ Premiere With Rare Performance & We Were Inside to Tell the Full Story
summary: On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast, Katie tells Keith all about seeing the pop superstar perform live for the first time since 2024.
tags: Pop Shop Podcast - New Every Tuesday
contentText:
Despite releasing her 12th studio album The Life of a Showgirl in 2025, the last time Taylor Swift mounted a proper performance was way back in December 2024, during her final stop on The Eras Tour. But on Tuesday night, Swift was back behind a piano to live-debut “I Knew It, I Knew You,” her just-released song from Toy Story 5 , at the Disney Pixar film’s world premiere, and we were among the lucky few inside Hollywood’s Dolby Theatre for the surprise set.

On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast , Katie tells Keith all about what it was like inside the room when Swift popped onstage for her own solo performance as well as a special duet with Toy Story musical mastermind Randy Newman for “You’ve Got a Friend in Me.” Hear all about it — no movie spoilers, we promise! — below:

Also on the show, we’ve got chart news on how Ariana Grande’s “Hate That I Made You Love Me” debuts atop the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart, while Paul McCartney notches his latest top 10 album on the Billboard 200 with The Boys of Dungeon Lane . Plus, Katie & Keith chat about two other big pop stories this week: P!nk wowing the Broadway world as the host of the 2026 Tony Awards on Sunday and Madonna bringing her Confessions II — The Film premiere to Tribeca late last week.

The  Billboard  Pop Shop Podcast  is your one-stop shop for all things pop on  Billboard ‘s weekly charts. You can always count on a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear  Billboard ‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and  Billboard ’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast, which can be streamed on Billboard.com or  downloaded in Apple  Podcasts  or your favorite podcast provider. ( Click here to listen to the previous edition of the show  on Billboard.com.)
